name: Costory
description:
Costory is a FinOps MCP. It lets Claude work as your FinOps Agent, exploring and explaining your cloud and AI spend across AWS, GCP, Azure, Datadog, Anthropic, Snowflake, and OpenAI.

Key features:
- Query costs by any dimension (service, team, environment, region) and compare periods with natural-language questions
- Build and update cost dashboards and reports
- Create budget alerts and cost-anomaly notifications
- Define cost allocations (virtual dimensions)
- Track cost-driving changes using annotated events
- Surface custom business and unit-economics metrics

The connector reads from your Costory workspace and requires a Costory account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Costory to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Costory to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app-api.costory.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Costory MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costory lists 37 MCP tools, including create_alert, create_dashboard, create_event, create_report, create_virtual_dimension_draft, delete_tag, get, get_context, get_dashboard_widget_data, get_dashboard_widget_image, get_documentation_page, and get_skill.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Costory?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Costory in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Costory requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Costory is developed by Costory. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
